name: moan
desc:
Each creature within 60 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that can hear its moan and that isn't an [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a  DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.
If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s moan for the next 24 hours.
Each creature within 60 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that can hear its moan and that isn't an [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} must make a Wisdom saving throw.
